details: The DeFi lending protocol Aave is grappling with a withdrawal crisis following a substantial exploit of Kelp DAO's rsETH bridge, which resulted in the loss of approximately $292 million in a LayerZero-based attack. This incident has spread risk across decentralized finance markets, impacting related protocols.
title: DeFi Lender Aave Faces Crisis After KelpDAO rsETH Exploit

details: The RaveDAO team has denied involvement in the significant pump and subsequent 68% crash of its RAVE token. Major cryptocurrency exchanges, Binance and Bitget, have reportedly initiated investigations into potential market manipulation surrounding the token's volatile price movements.
title: RaveDAO Denies Manipulation Amidst RAVE Token Crash and Exchange Investigations

details: Michael Saylor, founder of MicroStrategy, released a Bitcoin Tracker update, encouraging followers to "Think Even Bigger." Historically, MicroStrategy has disclosed additional Bitcoin holdings the day after such announcements, suggesting a potential for more large-scale Bitcoin purchases.
title: Michael Saylor Hints at Further Bitcoin Acquisitions Following Tracker Update

details: The Bitcoin network's mining difficulty has eased, sliding by 2.43%. Concurrently, the hashprice, which indicates the expected revenue for a given amount of hashrate, has seen a rise of 13.65%. These technical adjustments can impact mining profitability.
title: Bitcoin Network Difficulty Declines, Hashprice Rises

details: Ripple has highlighted that XRP is experiencing some of the fastest institutional adoption within the crypto space, particularly concerning its integration into US spot Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs). This indicates growing interest and acceptance of XRP by institutional investors.
title: Ripple Reports XRP's Institutional Adoption Among Fastest for US Spot ETFs
